about: #jbshrinkrestarts parity cases. The Rust `route_outcome` derivation (agent-doc-editor-surface) and the plugin's frozen Kotlin floor (RouteOutcomeTest) both answer every case. `input` is exactly what the plugin sends: the Run Agent Doc route's output and the document's relative path. The rules reproduce the pre-move Kotlin: java.util.regex ASCII `\s`/`\S`/`\d`/`\b`, Kotlin `trim`/`isBlank` whitespace, and `lines()` splitting at CRLF, LF, and CR. A native rule change updates this file and may diverge from the frozen floor only on purpose; a case whose native answer diverged on purpose keeps the frozen floor's answer in `frozen_expected`.

cases.name: a deferred switch on a paused queue offers restart and resume

input.output:
[route] target tmux session: 0
Error: authoritative actor record for tasks/agent-doc/agent-doc-bugs2.md is running harness claude-code, but frontmatter now resolves to codex; deferring to boundary agent restart instead of replacing live pane. queue is paused — the boundary restart will not fire until it is healthy and resumed.
